mentions.name: Pulse
mentions.description: A tiny CLI for running self-experiments on personal productivity. It automatically checks in and observes commits and code changes, with the goal of comparing work across three conditions: no AI, moderate AI (e.g. searching, inline assist), and full AI (agents).
mentions.problem: There was little real data on whether AI tools help or hurt personal productivity, leaving mostly speculation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm _currently_ writing a tiny CLI to run self-experiments on my own productivity, auto-checking in / observing commits/code changes.
